messages:
Jordan: quick proposal for rolling model-v2 into production on the /embed route. want to reduce wasted tokens vs a full broad canary but keep tight guards. sketch below.

Jordan: config idea — small-step percent schedule + metric gates. example: 
```yaml
route: /models/my-embed
from: model-v1
to: model-v2
schedule:
  - percent: 0.5
    duration: 15m
  - percent: 1
    duration: 30m
  - percent: 5
    duration: 1h
  - percent: 25
    duration: 2h
  - percent: 100
    duration: 6h
guards:
  p99_latency_ms: 220
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  quality_delta_pct: 1.5  # relative regression compared to baseline eval set
auto_advance: true
abort_on_failure: true
```

Sasha: I like the gradual (% increments) but can we make the steps dynamic? e.g. if quality/latency stabilize early, auto-advance faster; if a guard trips, pause & notify. also: consider a lower starting percent for high-cost routes (0.1%). :eyes:

Kevin: two questions: 1) where do we compute the "quality_delta_pct"? do we expect the platform to run mini-evals against a pinned prompt set during the canary window, or expect callers to provide hooks? 2) abort_on_failure should include a soft-fallback option (route-specific fallback to model-v1) that doesn't drop connections.

Jordan: answers — plan is platform-run quick-evals (sampled requests + synthetic prompt set) + telemetry comparisons vs baseline. we should expose both automatic checks and a manual-approve gate. fallback will be explicit in the rollout: `fallback: model-v1` and we keep sticky sessions on the old model for in-flight requests.

Priya: from console/UX side: need an API shape that's easy to render. suggest top-level `traffic_policy` object: 
```json
{"schedule_type":"percent_steps","auto_advance":true,"checks":["p99_latency_ms","error_rate_pct","quality_delta_pct"]}
```
Also want a preview mode that simulates expected token split & estimated cost delta before committing. can we add `dry_run: true`?

Sasha: +1 to dry_run. also recommend we expose a real-time small panel that shows the canary cohort's metric deltas and a link to the exact prompt sample set used for quality checks.

Kevin: ops question — what about quotas? if the canary suddenly uses more tokens per request we could blow customer or infra token budgets. need to surface per-route token burn radar and optionally cap canary traffic by token budget rather than percent. e.g. `cap_by_tokens: 1_000_000`

Jordan: good point. add `cap_by_tokens` and `cap_by_errors` to guards. will update sketch.

Priya: for console flow: create -> preview -> queue -> execute. show estimated time to full rollout, estimated cost delta, and prominent rollback button. notifications: slack + email + ops channel and require at least one oncall ack if `percent >= 25`.

Kevin: for API compatibility — keep current rollout endpoints but accept a `policy` blob. backwards-compatible fallback to old simple percent field. we can add a validation webhook so infra teams can reject unsafe policies (e.g., >50% immediate).

Jordan: plan of next steps: 1) Jordan to push a design doc w/ examples and edge cases (abort/rollback, stale KV cache handling, session affinity) by EOD. 2) Priya to mock console screens for preview + live telemetry. 3) Sasha/Kevin to prototype policy evaluation lambda and validation webhook. 4) ops-bot to run a dry-run test once we have a policy schema.

deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run canary for /models/my-embed (model-v2) queued at 1798124000 — will post results in #eng-platform when done. :rocket:

Sasha: :thumbsup:

Jordan: thanks all — will include sample YAML + minimal JSON schema in the doc.
